'''Cultes des Goules''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 2 movement points to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-2) check]].  If you pass, draw 1 [[Spell]] and gain 1 [[Clue token]], but lose 2 [[Sanity]] and discard Cultes Des Goules.  If you fail, nothing happens.

'''Price''': $3

==Mythos Source==

Cultes des Goules first appeared in ''The Suicide in the Study'' (1935), written by Robert Bloch.
